about: What a faulty Lua client script leaves behind, and four things that were not known. Seen in play on 2026-10-13: (1) A fault while the script runs comes into the log as a print with the place and a traceback: the click at play second 3 runs a handler that indexes nil, and the log has "CC_main:13: attempt to index a nil value (local 'nothing')" with "stack traceback: CC_main: 13: in function <CC_main:10>"; the 2 key at second 6 gives the same for line 24. What the handler printed before the fault is there, what came after is not. printerr lines are in the log like prints. (2) A script that does not compile never reaches the play: with cc_syntax_error.lua added as a third script (it is left out of this test), playtest_start fails at once with 试玩校验失败：脚本编译报错：CC_bad.lua:2: ')' expected. (3) OnUpdate is not called unless the script asked for it with script:EnableUpdate(true): this one never asks, and neither its fault at frame 120 nor its print at frame 240 shows. (4) A signal carries a parameter: the 1 key at second 5 makes the Lua send CC_say with AddString("hello"), and the graph prints CC_SAY hello. (5) A container that starts hidden is switched on by the graph at level second 16 (f.modifyUiControlStatusWithinTheInterfaceLayout with the id scene_add_client_ui returned): the red star appears and its script starts only then (CC_LUA late started). (6) A teleport inside the level (the playtest input at second 8) leaves the client controls as they are: the green disc stays and the script does not start again.
